description.value: Against your mark your strikes score a critical hit on a natural 19 as well as a 20, and your mark cannot be healed above the total it had when the duel started. The duel ends when you decide it has ended.

cinderfall.incomplete: Crits on a natural 19 against the mark; the mark can't be healed above its duel-start total. No rule element caps healing received by a different creature, and no companion effect exists to carry it -- compounded by the confirmed-unfireable mark predicate.
